description:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we're expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Recognized by industry analysts like Forrester and G2 and backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures,  we empower high-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe with the flexibility and insights needed to drive revenue performance.

 

Join a talented, fast-growing team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems in sales performance management.

 

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Project Manager to join our Professional Services team, leading our most complex and technically demanding enterprise SaaS implementations. This is a senior, high-impact role for a PMP-certified project management professional with deep experience managing enterprise SaaS deployments and a strong technical foundation. The ideal candidate is as comfortable in a technical architecture conversation with engineering and customer IT teams as they are managing executive stakeholders, and brings proven judgment for de-risking large-scale, multi-phase, multi-stakeholder implementations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee the planning, execution, monitoring, and closure of multiple customer projects.

  • Establish strong relationships with customer stakeholders, ensuring alignment on project goals and deliverables. Manage communication and expectation-setting throughout the project.

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, managing scope, schedule, resources, and budget. Track project progress and ensure adherence to milestones.

  • Identify potential risks and proactively implement mitigation strategies. Manage scope changes, budget adjustments, and timeline shifts through structured change control processes.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, ensuring proper allocation of resources for successful project execution.

  • Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including status reports, risk registers, and lessons learned. Provide regular updates to leadership and customers.

  • Leverage industry best practices and continuous improvement methodologies to enhance project execution and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Lead the full project lifecycle for enterprise-tier customer implementations, including complex data integrations, custom configurations, and multi-system architectures.

  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for enterprise customer stakeholders (VP/C-suite), driving alignment on scope, technical approach, and delivery milestones.

  • Partner closely with Solution Architects, Engineering, and Technical Consultants to assess technical risk, integration complexity, and deployment readiness.

  • Own and manage complex project plans across scope, schedule, resourcing, and budget for high-ARR, strategically important enterprise accounts.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate technical and delivery risk across long-duration, multi-phase implementations; lead structured change control for scope, budget, and timeline shifts.

  • Mentor and provide delivery guidance to junior and mid-level Project Managers on enterprise best practices and technical delivery standards.

  • Drive continuous improvement of enterprise delivery methodology, tooling, and technical playbooks across the Professional Services team.

  • Deliver executive-level status reporting, risk registers, and escalation summaries to both customer leadership and internal executives.

Qualifications & Experience

  • PMP certification required.

  • 10+ years of project management experience, with a significant portion managing enterprise SaaS implementations or deployments.

  • Strong technical acumen required: hands-on familiarity with data integration/ETL concepts, APIs, system architecture, and enterprise IT environments. Candidates with the strongest technical depth will be prioritized.

  • Experience with incentive compensation management, sales performance management, or related enterprise financial/SaaS software highly desirable.

  • Demonstrated track record delivering complex, multi-phase enterprise implementations on time and on budget.

  • Executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills; experience engaging directly with VP/C-suite customer sponsors.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Healthcare: 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision for all FTEs, with roughly 75% coverage for dependents.

  • Flexible Time Off: Flexible vacation days plus quarterly mental health days to ensure you have the space to recharge.

  • Annual Stipends: Dedicated funds for your professional development and caretaking needs.

  • Work Anniversary Bonuses: Annual bonuses to celebrate your milestones and contributions to the CaptivateIQ team that grow as your tenure does.

  • Retirement Savings (US-Only): A 401(k) plan to help you invest in and secure your future.

  • Premium Tools: The latest Apple hardware to empower you to do your best work.

  • Inclusive Community: Active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that celebrate shared identities and support our DEI goals by fostering an environment where diverse talent thrives.

CaptivateIQ participates in E-Verify, web-based system that allows enrolled employers to confirm the eligibility of their employees to work in the United States
